Attach sanitized reproduction evidence for UI/performance fixes. If the change includes a comparative performance claim, link the methodology and raw results in `docs/PERFORMANCE.md`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused scope with no unrelated generated files
- [ ] Regression tests added or updated
- [ ] Architecture/capability contracts preserved
- [ ] Credentials and private user data excluded
- [ ] Translations and accessibility reviewed for UI changes
- [ ] Dependency/asset licenses reviewed
- [ ] README or documentation updated for public behavior changes
- [ ] Limitations and untested platforms clearly identified

For security vulnerabilities, **do not open a public pull request with exploit details**. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
